_meta.description: External-data fixtures for Investigator Tier 1b (SoS + OpenCorporates) and Tier 2 (LinkedIn via Proxycurl + CourtListener). Mirrors the structure of real API responses 1:1 so swapping `DEMO_MODE=false` triggers no code changes — only the data source. Real API integration target documented in `_real_company_demo_target`.
_meta.schema_note: Fixture schemas mirror real API responses for zero-friction swap

tier_1b_apis.us_secretary_of_state: State-by-state portals (CA, NY, DE, TX scrapers wrapped in `src/public_data/sos.py`). Real call when DEMO_MODE=false.
tier_1b_apis.opencorporates: https://api.opencorporates.com/v0.4 — free tier 50 calls/day. Real call when DEMO_MODE=false.

tier_2_apis.linkedin: Proxycurl (https://nubela.co/proxycurl) — free tier 100 credits/month, 1 credit per person/company lookup. Real call when DEMO_MODE=false. API key in PROXYCURL_API_KEY env var (register before 2026-06-15).
tier_2_apis.courtlistener: https://www.courtlistener.com/api/rest/v4 — free, no key required. Real call when DEMO_MODE=false.

_real_company_demo_target.rationale: Decided 2026-06-10: B2B fintech, evaluator-recognizable, SoS-verifiable in CA/DE, public LinkedIn officer data. Used in the 10-second `real-company verification side bar` mid-demo to prove Tier 1b/2 integrations are not dead code.
demo_query_examples: Look up Mercury Technologies in CA SoS
Pull Mercury Technologies CFO from LinkedIn via Proxycurl
Check CourtListener for any litigation involving Mercury Technologies in last 12 months
